definitionBean.title: Tangent to a Circle
definitionBean.definition: A line that touches a circle at exactly one point is called a tangent.
definitionBean.explanation: The radius to the point of contact is perpendicular to the tangent.
importantPoints: A tangent touches at a single point
Angle between radius and tangent is 90°

parts.statement: From a point Q, the length of the tangent to a circle is 24 cm and the distance of Q from the center is 25 cm. Find the radius of the circle.

Prove that the tangents drawn at the ends of a diameter of a circle are parallel.
parts.explanation: Alternate interior angles are equal, hence parallel.

parts.statement: A quadrilateral ABCD is drawn to circumscribe a circle. Prove that AB + CD = AD + BC.

parts.statement: Prove that the angle between the two tangents drawn from an external point to a circle is supplementary to the angle subtended by the line-segment joining the points of contact at the center.
parts.explanation: Sum of opposite angles in quadrilateral is 180°.
